title: Design System: GrindCTRL Try-On Email Campaign

components.name: Reply DEMO Button
components.description: The only filled action in the campaign email.

components.name: Live Demo Link
components.description: A quieter secondary path for recipients who want to explore first.

components.name: Campaign Frame
components.description: The single structural container for the email.

narrative.overview: The campaign feels like a precisely cut black garment placed on clean white paper. The interface is disciplined and monochrome; the approved product visual supplies fashion context and warmth. Every decision must survive real inbox constraints.
keyCharacteristics: One primary and one secondary path

rules.name: The Monochrome Interface Rule
rules.body: No accent color appears in email UI. The original campaign image may retain its approved palette.

rules.name: The One Black Action Rule
rules.body: Only Reply DEMO receives the filled black treatment.

rules.name: The Inbox Font Rule
rules.body: Remote web fonts are forbidden in the email.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use spacing or a one-pixel full-width rule instead of decorative shadows.

dos: Do use the original logo and campaign image.
Do encode both MIME parts as UTF-8.
Do verify major inbox clients before activation.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS campaign styling.
Don't use excessive gold UI or ornamental serif typography.
Don't ship mojibake, missing images, clipped layouts, or browser-only CSS.
Don't use manipulative urgency or deceptive subject lines.
